head_metadata: packaging: add libc++ MLGO AOT assets
head_show_stat:
commit f203923a1508c9344f5fc6b17bd8822f011655c4
Author:     hao.lin <hao.lin@samsung.com>
AuthorDate: Fri Sep 11 23:33:26 2026 +0800
Commit:     hao.lin <hao.lin@samsung.com>
CommitDate: Fri Sep 11 23:33:26 2026 +0800

    packaging: add libc++ MLGO AOT assets
    
    Select the TensorFlow 2.18 libc++ AOT assets only for Clang toolchain builds while preserving the existing TensorFlow 2.15/libstdc++ path for GCC and non-toolchain builds.
    
    The MLGO TensorFlow 2.15 pin follows the tf-agents training-stack compatibility constraint, not the AOT compiler. LLVM has no CMake gate against TensorFlow 2.18, and all adjusted consumption interfaces remain in Tizen-controlled packaging; upstream C++ sources are unchanged.
    
    中文说明：仅在 Clang 工具链构建中选择 TensorFlow 2.18/libc++ AOT 资产；GCC 及未启用 libc++ 的路径继续使用原 TensorFlow 2.15/libstdc++ 资产。消费接口调整全部位于 Tizen 打包层，不修改上游 C++ 源码。

 packaging/llvm.spec                            |  33 +++++++++++++++++++++++++
 packaging/mlgo_aarch_model_libcxx_tf218.tar.gz | Bin 0 -> 23323930 bytes
 packaging/mlgo_arm_model_libcxx_tf218.tar.gz   | Bin 0 -> 23336748 bytes
 packaging/mlgo_x86_model_libcxx_tf218.tar.gz   | Bin 0 -> 23438321 bytes
 4 files changed, 33 insertions(+)
head_patch:
diff --git a/packaging/llvm.spec b/packaging/llvm.spec
index c901dc5a2..15a4f7367 100644
--- a/packaging/llvm.spec
+++ b/packaging/llvm.spec
@@ -15,6 +15,12 @@
 %define llvm_release_build 1
 %endif
 
+%if %{defined _toolchain}
+%if %{toolchain_is clang}
+%define build_with_libcxx 1
+%endif
+%endif
+
 %define llvm_version 22
 
 %define sdk_install_prefix /home/owner/share/tmp/sdk_tools/lldb
@@ -44,6 +50,11 @@ Source1001: llvm.manifest
 Source1002: mlgo_arm_model.tar.gz
 Source1003: mlgo_aarch_model.tar.gz
 Source1004: mlgo_x86_model.tar.gz
+# TensorFlow 2.18 AOT assets rebuilt with libc++ for the toolchain build.
+# The original TensorFlow 2.15/libstdc++ assets remain the default elsewhere.
+Source1005: mlgo_arm_model_libcxx_tf218.tar.gz
+Source1006: mlgo_aarch_model_libcxx_tf218.tar.gz
+Source1007: mlgo_x86_model_libcxx_tf218.tar.gz
 
 %{!?mlgo_build_jobs: %define mlgo_build_jobs 6}
 %{!?mlgo_verify_configure_only: %define mlgo_verify_configure_only 0}
@@ -58,6 +69,10 @@ BuildRequires: libxml2-devel
 BuildRequires: sed
 %endif
 BuildRequires: ninja
+%if 0%{?build_with_libcxx}
+BuildRequires: libc++-devel
+BuildRequires: libc++abi-devel
+%endif
 
 
 Requires: libllvm = %{version}-%{release}
@@ -156,6 +171,17 @@ Python bindings to parts of the Clang library
 %setup -q
 %if %{with mlgo}
 mkdir -p mlgo_verify_assets
+%if 0%{?build_with_libcxx}
+%ifarch armv7l
+tar -C mlgo_verify_assets -xzf %{SOURCE1005}
+%endif
+%ifarch aarch64
+tar -C mlgo_verify_assets -xzf %{SOURCE1006}
+%endif
+%ifarch x86_64
+tar -C mlgo_verify_assets -xzf %{SOURCE1007}
+%endif
+%else
 %ifarch armv7l
 tar -C mlgo_verify_assets -xzf %{SOURCE1002}
 %endif
@@ -166,6 +192,7 @@ tar -C mlgo_verify_assets -xzf %{SOURCE1003}
 tar -C mlgo_verify_assets -xzf %{SOURCE1004}
 %endif
 %endif
+%endif
 
 %build
 %if 0%{llvm_release_build}
@@ -207,8 +234,14 @@ cmake \
     -DCMAKE_C_FLAGS="$CFLAGS" \
     -DCMAKE_CXX_FLAGS="$CXXFLAGS" \
 %if %{defined _toolchain}
+%if 0%{?build_with_libcxx}
+    -DLLVM_ENABLE_LIBCXX=ON \
+    -DCMAKE_SHARED_LINKER_FLAGS="-fuse-ld=lld -ffunction-sections -fdata-sections -Wl,--gc-sections -Wl,--no-as-needed -lc++abi -Wl,--as-needed" \
+    -DCMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS="-fuse-ld=lld -ffunction-sections -fdata-sections -Wl,--gc-sections -Wl,--no-as-needed -lc++abi -Wl,--as-needed" \
+%else
     -DCMAKE_SHARED_LINKER_FLAGS="-fuse-ld=lld -ffunction-sections -fdata-sections -Wl,--gc-sections" \
     -DCMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS="-fuse-ld=lld -ffunction-sections -fdata-sections -Wl,--gc-sections" \
+%endif
     -DLLVM_USE_LINKER=lld \
 %endif
     -DLLVM_ENABLE_ASSERTIONS=No \
